text: Not another chatbot. Your workspace: Word, Excel and PowerPoint, together.
Start from your templates, or just describe it.
Tell it what changed, once. It finds where that number lives: the model, the memo, the deck.
Assistants plan the work, check it, and hand it off. The validated number travels with them.
No regenerating. It edits the cell, the sentence, the slide element, and leaves the rest alone.
Every change is marked, in every file. Accept it, or reject it. Even slide four.
And every change comes with its evidence, so you can check it before you trust it.
